coverage.summary: Proposed ordinance. It would cover residential rental property in the City of San Diego, defined by reference to SDMC § 98.0702 as any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobilehome park. Landlord is also defined by reference to § 98.0702. No unit-count, construction-date or landlord-size limits are stated. The Division 7 exemptions in § 98.0703 are not incorporated.

result.notes: Removed other_conditions. It described which software counts as an algorithmic device, which is regulated conduct rather than a building, unit or owner attribute. Rewrote the summary to describe property scope only and to support it verbatim. The § 98.0703 exemptions (for example, certificate of occupancy within 15 years, owner-occupied single-family) apply only to 'this Division' (Division 7). The proposed Division 11 borrows only the § 98.0702 definitions, so no construction or unit limits were carried over. The ordinance is a draft with a blank passage date.
